invariants: Reject unknown keys, duplicate source/component, unsafe integers, bool-as-int, nonfinite values and nonallowlisted strings.
This array contains failure/unavailable evidence, not successful-source metadata. Valid readable zero has no failure record.

A completed capture or bridge contains only diagnostics for its current missing/unavailable source, with reason matching unavailableReasons. Fatal Contacts evidence is local only because required Contacts still fail closed.
All fields enter schema1 payload or schema2 manifest hash, per-category Save fingerprint, persisted source receipt and report readback. Never place personal source rows in diagnostics.

unsupported_size_growth is diagnostic-only: proof statuses do not establish size reconciliation, SQLite integrity, or historical completeness. It never permits import of a larger encrypted Messages copy. Receivers must recognize this code before a changed companion is distributed.
Older payloads may omit this field. Do not infer validation facts for older reports.
Historical local diagnostics must be labeled previous run and never attached to a new capture or Save.

localRetention.identity: random attempt UUID only; no account or device identity
localRetention.location: private marker-owned diagnostics directory beside sessions; never in temporary backup sessions
localRetention.failure: fixed diagnostic-storage state visible; never raw exceptions/paths

nativeEvents.selected-payload-diagnostic: existing event now carries exact normalized failure record plus kind
nativeEvents.capture: optional sourceDiagnostics for this current capture only
nativeEvents.residue: optional sourceDiagnosticHistory loaded from durable store
